headline: ARC-2 gold line rises as Enes Kulak closes in

sections.text: The score needed for the last of 16 provisional ARC-2 gold places rose 1.53 in the past day to 68.06.
Enes Kulak is 17th at 66.11, 1.95 short of that line.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
